sources.title: 中村璋八《五行大義鈔本・版本の傳流とその資料的價値》
sources.provider: Japan Science and Technology Agency, China/Asia Research Papers Database; 日本中國學會報10, pp77–90
sources.quality_notes: Actual screenshots PDF indices 0–4,12–13 (pp77–81,89–90); index11 timed out. p80 author compares Genroku print, Genko copy and Yicun reprint; p81 distinguishes subsequent Chinese editions and 1939 series. pp89–90 discuss mixed annotations and infer older manuscript circulation from quotations, with explicit caution. Author's collation, not independently recalculated; no target ancient folio.
